comments.body:
I would like to propose the following spec change

* https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3832

I won't be able to make it but would like to confirm consensus and/or get a temperature check on:

1) preference to have CL drive blob limits, but _NOT_ handle gas/fee computations (context: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3800 vs https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3813)
2) do we realistically see ourselves changing the blob target to anything other than `MAX // 2`? if we do, then we should also have the CL send target along with max values (with the resulting extension of the EL header to have both values)
